title: From God to the Atom and Back
subtitle: An exploration of the browser-based writer

blocks.html: This article reviews a recent publication by a team of eleven co-authors at Pragma Research, a private firm in Washington State. The project materials, including a technical paper and a book-length discussion, introduce a framework for a Theory of Everything—that is, a theory of fundamental physics that may be capable of “unifying” physics—called Observer Patch Holography, also the name of the project’s GitHub repository.·
